title: Read-replica ledger lag causing out-of-order invoice deltas
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description: Several customers across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments reported invoice deltas and negative line-items after a regional maintenance window. Root cause appears to be a window where read-replicas lag behind the ledger primary long enough that the billing export job reads stale counters and emits out-of-order deltas. The billing pipeline assumes monotonic ledger reads per tenant for export snapshots; when replica lag > checkpoint interval, we produce corrective deltas that manifest as negative credits or missing usage on invoices. This ticket tracks diagnosis, short-term mitigations, and the permanent fix (write-ack strategy + export read affinity).
observed_behavior:
- Customers A and B saw negative credit line items for Feb 12-13 exports.
- Billing export job produced two snapshots with regression deltas instead of monotonic increments.
- Replay/backfill attempts produced duplicated corrections when run against different replica topologies.
- Affected environments: hosted-us-east, dedicated-eu-1, private-customer-42 (on-prem).
reproduction_steps:
1) Create tenant and generate continuous requests for 24+ hours.
2) Force a primary failover or induce sustained load on primary to create replication lag on read replicas.
3) Trigger billing export job at regular checkpoint interval (00:00 UTC).
4) Observe exported deltas show non-monotonic sequence numbers and negative adjustments in invoice preview.
5) Confirm logs on ledger-primary show commit sequence S and read-replica returns sequence S-5 at snapshot time.
root_cause_summary: Asynchronous replication allowed a read-replica to return stale counter state to the billing exporter. The exporter lacked a verification step to detect monotonic sequence or commit timestamps, and it did not prefer primary reads during suspected maintenance windows. A contributing factor was an optimistic idempotency/merge path in the export aggregator that applied reverse deltas instead of deferring until primary-confirmed commits.
short_term_mitigation:
- Pause automated invoice exports for affected tenants until backfill completes.
- Run fencing script to pin billing exports to the primary for 6 hours post-maintenance.
- Manual reconciliations and credits applied for impacted customers (see support PR #SUP-4121).
- Customer comms drafted and sent to top 5 impacted accounts with RCA ETA.
permanent_fix_proposal:
1) Change billing exporter to prefer primary reads or require commit-seal metadata from replica.
2) Add monotonicity check on exported snapshots (sequence number/timestamp) and abort export if violated.
3) Ensure exporter increments are idempotent-only (no negative counter application without primary confirmation).
4) Add alerting for replica-lag > 30s for any region running export jobs.
5) Run a one-off backfill job that reconciles ledger primary state to exported billing snapshots for the last 7 days.
deployment_plan:
- Patch exporter and deploy to staging (billing-2025.03).
- Run integration tests against induced replica lag scenarios.
- Gradual rollout: hosteds then dedicated pools then private clusters (with customer opt-in window).
- Coordinate with SRE for maintenance window and post-deploy monitoring (72-hour observation).
rollback_plan: Revert exporter to previous release and pause exports for tenants if any regressions in monotonicity checks cause blocked billing runs; provide manual reconciliation path.
tests_and_checks:
- Unit tests for monotonicity verification.
- Integration test harness simulating replica lag (see infra job: infra-billing/replica-lag-sim).
- Canary on non-customer tenant and then low-volume tenants.
- Add dashboards: billing/export-sequence-skew, replica-lag-per-region.
